prompt_preview:
Below is an RFP, split into numbered blocks. Each block shows its ID, type and RFP section.

TASK: list every requirement the client places on the consultant or on the proposal.

CATEGORIES (use exactly one):
- "Scope": work or activities the consultant must carry out
- "Deliverable": tangible outpu

requirements.requirement: Execute a comprehensive mapping of existing patient journeys throughout the network of 4 hospitals and 12 outpatient clinics.
requirements.source_quote: The Supplier will execute a comprehensive mapping of existing patient journeys throughout our entire network of 4 hospitals and 12 outpatient clinics.

requirements.requirement: Perform a rigorous analysis of waiting-time data covering the previous 24 months for emergency departments and outpatient services.
requirements.source_quote: bidders are required to perform a rigorous analysis of waiting-time data covering the previous 24 months for both our emergency departments and outpatient services.

requirements.requirement: Conduct no fewer than 60 in-depth interviews with patients and clinical staff members.
requirements.source_quote: the engagement must involve conducting no fewer than 60 in-depth interviews with our patients and clinical staff members.

requirements.requirement: Conduct a thorough audit to assess patient data handling adherence to national health data protection regulations.
requirements.source_quote: It is expected that the partner will conduct a thorough audit to assess whether our current handling of patient data strictly adheres to all applicable national health data protection regulations.

requirements.requirement: Benchmark network operational performance against a minimum of five peer-level international hospital groups.
requirements.source_quote: the firm will benchmark our network's operational performance against a minimum of five peer-level international hospital groups to identify gaps and best-in-class practices.

requirements.requirement: Recommend a digital front-door strategy including online appointment booking, a symptom-triage chatbot, and a branded patient mobile app.
requirements.source_quote: The partner will recommend a comprehensive digital front-door strategy, which must include specifications for online appointment booking systems, an integrated symptom-triage chatbot, and a branded patient mobile application.

requirements.requirement: Develop a workforce scheduling optimization model tailored for doctors and nurses.
requirements.source_quote: Additionally, the Supplier is tasked with developing a robust workforce scheduling optimization model specifically tailored for our doctors and nurses.

requirements.requirement: Design a formal program governance model with a dedicated steering board and monthly KPI reviews.
requirements.source_quote: Bidders must design a formal program governance model, incorporating a dedicated steering board and a cadence for monthly KPI reviews.

requirements.requirement: Provide a detailed change management and training plan directed at all frontline staff members.
requirements.source_quote: Furthermore, the partner will provide a detailed change management and training plan directed at all frontline staff members operating across our full network of hospitals and clinics.

requirements.requirement: Deliver a baseline diagnostic report covering current patient experience and operations.
requirements.source_quote: 3.1 Baseline diagnostic report covering the current state of patient experience and operations.

requirements.requirement: Deliver a prioritised initiative roadmap including a cost-benefit estimate for every proposed initiative.
requirements.source_quote: 3.2 A prioritised initiative roadmap, including a detailed cost-benefit estimate for every proposed initiative.

requirements.requirement: Deliver an interactive dashboard visualizing patient-experience KPIs and hand it over to the internal IT team.
requirements.source_quote: 3.3 An interactive dashboard visualizing patient-experience KPIs, which must be fully handed over to our internal IT team upon completion.

requirements.requirement: Provide the final report in both English and Arabic.
requirements.source_quote: 3.4 To ensure accessibility across our stakeholder base, the final report must be provided in both English and Arabic.

requirements.requirement: Provide weekly written progress updates to the project sponsor.
requirements.source_quote: 3.5 The Supplier will provide weekly written progress updates directly to the project sponsor.

requirements.requirement: Complete the engagement within a maximum timeframe of 20 weeks.
requirements.source_quote: The engagement is expected to be completed within a maximum timeframe of 20 weeks.

requirements.requirement: Begin on-site work within 10 working days following the contract award.
requirements.source_quote: Following the contract award, the Supplier must begin on-site work within 10 working days.

requirements.requirement: Present interim findings no later than week 10 of the project.
requirements.source_quote: Furthermore, the partner is required to present their interim findings no later than week 10 of the project.

requirements.requirement: Provide a minimum of three references from healthcare clients located within the GCC region.
requirements.source_quote: 5.1 Bidders must provide a minimum of three references from healthcare clients located within the GCC region.

requirements.requirement: Structure the pricing model as a fixed fee with an option for milestone-based payments.
requirements.source_quote: 5.2 The pricing model must be structured as a fixed fee, with the inclusion of an option for milestone-based payments.

requirements.requirement: Name a dedicated clinical advisor with at least 10 years of professional hospital experience.
requirements.source_quote: 5.3 The bidding firm is required to name a dedicated clinical advisor who possesses at least 10 years of professional hospital experience.

skipped_sections.reason: Contains background reference and RFP identification details.
Contains background and contextual information about the client.
Contains evaluation weights and criteria rather than consultant or proposal obligations.
Contains submission logistics regarding where, how, and when to submit proposals.
